long_biography.plain_text:
Finazzo entered aviation from both legal and technical directions. After earning political science and law degrees, he founded Southern Express Airways in 1981 and later held contracting and general-counsel roles across aircraft leasing and engine maintenance companies. He also earned an FAA Airframe and Powerplant licence, grounding his corporate work in hands-on technical credentials.

At AeroTurbine, Finazzo and Robert Nichols combined aircraft and engine sales, leasing, parts and maintenance services as co-founders. The partners sold the business to Cerberus and, after its integration into AerCap, launched AerSale in 2008. As chairman and chief executive, Finazzo has expanded the company across asset management, maintenance, used serviceable material and engineered aircraft systems.
